reviewListing.title: Review Listing

payment.title: Payment Summary
payment.subtitle: Review the payroll breakdown and complete the payment to publish this event.
payment.selfDesc: You review all applicants and approve or reject each one. Best for clients who want full control.
payment.selfFeature3Desc: Choose who works at your event.
payment.eveforceDesc: We will source, screen, and assign the most suitable freelancers for your event.
payment.eveforceFeature1Desc: We match you with the most suitable, reliable talent.
payment.eveforceFeature2Desc: Save time with our efficient screening and selection.
payment.eveforceFeature3Desc: We provide replacements if needed, at no extra cost.
payment.escrowNotice: Your payment is held securely in escrow by EveForce. Funds are released to freelancers only after event completion and your confirmation.

payment.publishedNotice: Once published, freelancers will be able to view and apply to your listings immediately.
payment.publishSuccess: Event published! Your listings are now live.

profileSample.overviewP1: MDLBEAST Soundstorm is one of the Middle East's largest music and entertainment festivals, featuring international artists, immersive stage productions, and large-scale live experiences in Riyadh.
profileSample.overviewP2: We're seeking experienced event photographers who can capture live performances, audience energy, and behind-the-scenes moments in fast-paced festival environments.
profileSample.overviewP3: The festival is celebrated for its world-class production quality, cutting-edge lighting and visual effects, and an unforgettable atmosphere that blends music, culture, and innovation into a truly extraordinary live experience.
profileSample.industryTags: Music Festivals · Live Events · Experiences · Talent Management
profileSample.review1Quote: Professional team and smooth shift management throughout the event. Great experience with a positive work environment.
profileSample.review2Quote: Everything was planned efficiently, from onboarding to shift completion. A reliable organizer that values its freelancers.
profileSample.review3Quote: Well-organized event, clear communication, and on-time payment. Looking forward to working with MDLBEAST again.
